safetyNotes: Never infer firmware readback from visible Synapse state.

OpenBlade service startup can apply its saved OpenBlade-owned Off profile before Windows delegation is enabled. After delegation, reapply the desired external-controller state once and independently read it back; the validated Static 50 percent state survived an OpenBlade service restart.
The 0711 USB-C mapping is admitted only by the exact PID 02C6 production factory after three identical independent reads. Do not generalize it to another model without that model's own evidence.
Never run USBPcap and OpenBlade control concurrently.
Active Synapse host-rendered lighting can race the shared feature response.

An acknowledged isolated Spectrum transition is not installed lifecycle proof. Spectrum advanced only after the exact fixed build kept the installed UI and service healthy through a 12-second continuous-renderer hold and restored the saved Static profile.
Do not broaden PID 02E0 commands or geometry to PID 02C6 without exact-device evidence.
